status.idea: Concept or design note only; no install target.
status.prototype: Works in demos; APIs unstable; may lack tests.
status.experimental: Usable with caveats; breaking changes likely.
status.canary: Default for active integration branches; dogfooded internally.
status.deprecated: Still present; do not start new work here.
status.reference: Illustrative or historical; not a product surface.

execution.shadow: Emits side-channel telemetry only; no user-visible effect.
execution.log_only: Records decisions; does not act on them.
execution.canary: Partial live path; gated or opt-in.

invariants: Desired intent and runtime-safe plan remain distinguishable.
invalidators: Runtime executes an uncompiled intent while claiming compiled-plan semantics.

invariants: Hidden high-relevance concepts make a compressed view insufficient rather than silently complete.
Visible concepts retain provenance back to the reconstructable source world.
Structural entropy is not mislabeled as semantic information content.
invalidators: A compressed map claims sufficiency while omitting concepts above its relevance threshold.
The compressed view cannot reconstruct visible claims back to source provenance.

invariants: Hierarchy changes remain proposals until a human changes canonical z0.
Declared nodes are never automatic prune candidates.
Weak evidence resolves to no-update rather than forcing taxonomy change.
invalidators: A meta-learning proposal directly mutates canonical architecture.
A declared concept is automatically pruned from weak historical evidence.

invariants: Destination Keel revalidates authority before bounded execution.
Transport receipts do not silently mutate canonical Kanban lifecycle state.
invalidators: Transported data executes without destination authority revalidation.
Receipt projection completes or reviews a task without the canonical lifecycle owner.

invariants: Decision space is explicit and bounded before typed scoring/readout.
Receipt identifies enough context to audit the decision.
invalidators: Free-form generation substitutes for the bounded decision while retaining the same semantic label.

invariants: Compressed evidence remains quote-verifiable.
Verification failure falls open rather than silently inventing evidence.
invalidators: Verification failure is accepted as valid compressed evidence.

invariants: Cost/token/latency claims come from measurement evidence rather than architecture inference.
invalidators: Economic metrics are reconstructed solely from model/provider assumptions.

invariants: Raw messages remain recoverable after active-context compaction.
Summary nodes retain source lineage and bounded drill-down paths.
invalidators: Compaction deletes the only recoverable copy of source messages.
A summary is presented as lossless without a path back to its source lineage.

invariants: Original observation remains exactly recallable through the stable handle.
Large context remains externally addressable rather than being irreversibly discarded.
The coding-agent runtime remains authoritative for execution.
invalidators: RLM/context-spill implementation is removed from OMP.
The mechanism moves to another authoritative runtime without the registry being updated.
abstain_if: selected implementation ref cannot provide either architecture documentation or source evidence.

invariants: Observed execution remains distinguishable from intended execution.
Missing trace evidence is represented as missing, not synthesized.
invalidators: Observed topology is inferred without trace/runtime evidence and presented as fact.

invariants: Published claims resolve to pinned study artifacts.
Source-reported benchmarks and reproduced measurements remain distinct.
A label-generating system does not silently become its own verifier.
invalidators: A public claim cannot resolve to frozen evidence.
Private traces or secrets are included in the public evaluation artifact.

attributes.rule: Lower-authority observations may expose drift but never silently overwrite declared architecture.

attributes.name: Evolution Lab candidate promotion
attributes.rule: Experiment genomes are eliminated cheaply and promoted only after measured replay/verifier evidence; preview/nightly branches carry rolling candidates.

attributes.rule: Evidence-gated work moves through increasingly authoritative surfaces; workers do not merge main.

nodes.label: AODL intent → compiled plan → observed topology

attributes.name: AODL intent → compiled plan → observed topology
attributes.purpose: Keep desired orchestration, runtime-safe compiled plan and observed topology distinct so intended and actual execution can be compared.

attributes.name: Frozen evaluation publication
attributes.purpose: Turn pinned experiment inputs and independently inspectable outcomes into frozen datasets, analyses, figures, and public claims without becoming the experiment engine or verifier.

attributes.name: Recoverable context DAG
attributes.purpose: Keep active context bounded while preserving raw-message lineage, hierarchical summaries, exact drill-down, and recoverable externalized payloads.

attributes.name: Jev / typed bounded decision
attributes.purpose: Replace autoregressive choice generation with bounded typed scoring/readout when the decision space is explicit.

attributes.name: Keel governed execution
attributes.purpose: Bound agent execution with explicit capability rules, evidence requirements, staged promotion, adversarial verification, rollback, and non-self-authorizing evolution.

attributes.name: Signed Mesh intent transport
attributes.purpose: Transport bounded signed execution intents between nodes while revalidating authority at the destination and returning signed receipt/evidence without replacing the canonical task lifecycle.

attributes.name: Model passport identity
attributes.purpose: Keep maker, canonical model identity, verified capabilities, lifecycle, and serving route distinct while exposing one portable descriptor to every UI.

attributes.name: Realtime voice orchestration
attributes.purpose: Keep a duplex voice session active while delegating durable background agent work, querying memory/tools, and speaking results when they arrive.

attributes.name: RLM context spill
attributes.purpose: Keep large context addressable outside the frontier model's active window.

attributes.name: SoL-Pi Action Fusion
attributes.purpose: Fuse an edit/write and its predictable validation into one tool action.

attributes.name: SoL-Pi Evidence-Preserving Reducer
attributes.purpose: Compress long diagnostic observations into receipts while retaining quote-verifiable evidence and falling open on verification failure.

attributes.name: SoL-Pi ObservationPack
attributes.purpose: Replace repeated large observations with stable handles and exact recall.

attributes.name: SoL-Pi Online Context Compact
attributes.purpose: Trigger bounded context compaction at completed plan boundaries using economics/window pressure rather than replaying completed work indefinitely.

attributes.name: Split-authority privilege broker
attributes.purpose: Separate request, operator approval, immutable grant, and bounded privileged execution so an agent cannot manufacture its own elevation authority.

attributes.name: Slow architecture hierarchy meta-learning
attributes.purpose: Analyze architecture history for conservative keep, merge, split, prune, or no-update proposals while keeping canonical ontology changes human-approved.

attributes.name: Replayable architecture fork and diff
attributes.purpose: Preserve content-addressed architecture history as event-sourced runs that can be replayed, forked at prior states, reconciled to alternate ref selections, and structurally diffed without contaminating canonical truth.

attributes.name: Loss-aware semantic architecture compression
attributes.purpose: Compile a large architecture world into question- or zoom-conditioned maps while emitting receipts for retained structure, hidden evidence, cut edges, provenance reconstructability, and high-relevance omissions.
